desc: The Remington 1816 Precision Double Barrel Shotgun seamlessly blends classic elegance with exceptional craftsmanship, making it the perfect choice for both hunting and sporting use. Its Turkish walnut stock and splinter forend offer a timeless aesthetic, while the case-hardened steel frame and blued 28 inches barrels provide durability and strength. Designed with ejectors, a Prince of Wales straight cast stock and a fitted recoil pad, the Remington 1816 ensures both reliable performance and comfort for the shooter. The 20 Gauge design, interchangeable Rem Chokes and bead sights enhance versatility and accuracy, allowing for an optimal shooting experience in various field conditions. Whether you're aiming for precision or simply enjoying the art of shooting, the Remington 1816 Precision Double Barrel Shotgun stands out as a top-tier choice.
